bluefireF5ran sent eighteen ideas, and every one of them is in this release. The table reads at a glance, your play area sorts the way you like, the pickers fold and roll at random, the deck check shows every face of a card, and Your stats keeps every seat's decks, with an export for MC Tracker. Clear the Area, Daredevil's Sense deck and Mod Store scenario difficulties are fixed too.

for your play area, your deck list and extra modular sets.

Read the table at a glance

Issues #763, #765, #766, #767, #769 · PR #772

The table says more without a hover. The main scheme tells you how much threat it gains each round, a stat whose card prints a star shows that star, an attachment says what removing it costs, and a deck the next round will empty turns light red.

What the table shows now

  • +N per round under the main scheme, from its stage, acceleration icons and tokens.
  • A small white star on a stat whose card prints one, from 571 entries in the card data.
  • An attachment's chip shows what removing it costs as resource and hero icons, with the cost in words in Inspect and on narrower screens.
  • A player side scheme fills its bar in player blue, so it never looks like the villain's.

Decks running out

The encounter deck and its discard read LOW in light red when the next villain phase needs more cards than the deck holds, and your deck does the same before the end-of-round draw.

It counts boost cards, each player's encounter card, heroic level and hazard icons the way the Rules Reference does, and the game deals from the same numbers it shows you.

Your play area, in order

Issues #768, #764 · PR #777

Settings ▸ Cards has a Play area order now: As played, By type, By cost or By name. It only changes how your play area is drawn, never the game, and there is no button on the table for a stray click to hit.

Surge is easier to follow. The log names the card that surged and marks the card its surge dealt, and the villain phase's encounter strip tags them SURGE and FROM SURGE.

Find your game faster

Issues #753, #755, #759, #760, #761, #762 · PR #778

The hero and scenario lists fold. Tap a cycle's header to fold its shelf, and SEE ALL at the header's right end opens the box. Scenario select rolls at random at every step, and the title menu gets a Discord button.

Pick it, or let it pick

  • Folds are remembered per list, and a search or a filter opens them all so every match shows.
  • Random box, Random scenario and Random villain draw only from what that step shows, and skip locked scenarios.
  • Deck list on open picks the list the Decks screen starts on, and Show preconstructed decks can hide the precons there.

Sharper and wider

  • Title backgrounds too small for your screen are no longer stretched, so they stop looking pixelated.
  • Allow extra modular sets lets Table setup add sets beyond the scenario's count. Those games stay out of global stats, the same as Skirmish.

Every face, every pack

Issues #754, #758, #770 · PR #779

The deck check shows the whole identity: Hero, Alter-Ego and any extra hero form, then both sides of every double-sided card in the deck. Every face opens the card hover.

  • A Past games cover reads the pack from the save itself, so the art shows even after the pack is removed, and the names show if the art is gone.
  • A Mod Store pack lists Hero, Villain and scheme, Obligation, Nemesis set, Scenario set, each modular set by name, then aspect and basic cards.

Your decks, in numbers

Issues #756, #757 · PR #781

Your stats has a Decks tab. Every deck played at any seat, with its record, win rate, hero and aspects, and its most played cards with how often you played and drew them.

Kept for every seat

  • Each seat's deck and the cards it drew are saved with the game, beside the cards it played.
  • Older games are replayed once in the background to fill these in.
  • A deck name you typed stays out of shared replay files and issue reports.

Export for MC Tracker

  • Past games saves the won and lost games on the tab you're on as a CSV, one row per game, for marvelchampionstracker.com.
  • Scenario, modular sets, difficulty, mode, then each hero, aspects, deck name and MarvelCDB link, when the deck has one.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #773, #782, #786 · PRs #774, #784, #787
#773 · reported by @sgaon42

Clear the Area draws with Shrink

Clear the Area draws a card when it removes the last threat on a scheme. With Shrink raising the removal, it cleared the scheme and drew nothing.

Now it draws whenever its thwart takes the last threat, however much it removed, and even when the scheme gets threat back right away, as The Search for Spiral does.

Ruling, October 10, 2025: Clear the Area still draws after The Search for Spiral.
#782 · reported by @javgoro

Play it from the Sense deck

Daredevil's Superhuman Senses plays the top card of the Sense deck, but tapping the deck only showed the card.

Now the top card has a Play it button while the Action can be used, and the log names a Sense upgrade going back into the deck instead of calling it a facedown card.

#786 · reported by @zackburnley on Discord

Every difficulty for Mod Store scenarios

A scenario from a Mod Store pack only offered Standard, Expert and heroic. Now Set the table gives it the same row an official scenario has: Standard set I, II or III, Expert set I or II, and Skirmish.

The scenario packs already in the store, Mephisto among them, get all of it with no change to their data.

Also in v0.48.0

PRs #752, #776
  • A Mod request issue form asks for a mod to join the Mod Store: its kind, its creator, their permission and a link or the files.
  • Each release opens the Mod Store registry's update to the new mod SDK by itself.
